research_question: Does the existing simple trend breakout provide a distinct and economically usable portfolio path relative to the frozen VCP leader strategy?

known_before_overlap_audit.interpretation_constraint: Later low overlap or correlation can be caused by capital depletion and minimum-lot rejection. It cannot be treated as diversification.

pre_registered_metrics: daily return correlation on all dates and the union of exposed dates
control entries when the primary portfolio ends the day at four positions
control top-five winner share of gross positive PnL
decision_rules: Do not promote or combine a control that loses economic viability under the frozen current contract.
Do not repair the observed result by changing its window, volume threshold, stop, exit, score, holding period or position count.
Do not attribute the result solely to VCP structure because the methods also differ in market regime, relative strength, filters, ranking and exits.
Use overlap only to classify the control and close the current P3 comparison; do not optimize combined weights.
stop_condition: Run the descriptive overlap once. If the control is economically nonviable, stop this default strategy family and retain it only as a null reference.
development_note: This uses exposed history and a catastrophically depleted control path. It is not an independent alpha estimate or a basis for parameter repair.
